$doc: The stack profile. Every path, package and command in this kit is read from here. Run /adapt to fill it in — do not hand-edit unless you know what you are changing. Reference: obsidian/architecture/stack-profile.md
notes: Source is the GetLayers 'Relay' template (.getlayers/build.json), built on textura-agency/next16-claude-starter. The project's own vault (obsidian/) predates this kit and is canonical for project specifics: obsidian/frontend/animation-system.md and text-engine.md are the motion notes for THIS code; motion-system.md / text-motion.md are the kit's framework-neutral versions.
Style entry is src/app/globals.css; it @imports per-section CSS from src/style/sections/*.css. src/style/index.css is a commented-out legacy entry.
paths.protected is the vendored animation engine (AGENTS.md hard rule 2). One authorised refactor exists — see obsidian/meta/decisions-log.md ADR-0009.
Next 16: middleware.ts is proxy.ts (node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md). Read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing routing/metadata/data code.
The fixed full-page three.js scene lives in src/views/home/stream/ — performance work goes through the optimize-3d-scene skill.

Lint: no-explicit-any / ban-ts-comment / no-unused-vars are ON for app code and OFF only for paths.protected (ADR-0030); react-hooks/set-state-in-effect is a warning, not an error. verify.sh also enforces no-any outside the engine.
No typecheck script; `yarn build` runs the TypeScript check. `npx tsc --noEmit` works ad hoc.

CMS/DB vendor for this project is Payload + Supabase (project AGENTS.md rule 12) — use the payload-cms / supabase-db / supabase-auth skills (/db) rather than the kit's generic headless-cms / database / auth skills.
Node: .nvmrc pins 24.16.0; package.json engines >=20.19.0; works on 22.x.

Theme: light-only brand palette (ADR-0031) — paper/white/ink/stone/orange; Brand fonts only (ADR-0036): Playfair Display Medium (font-display, titles h1–h3), Cormorant Garamond (font-serif, subtitles/accent words), Public Sans (font-sans, paragraphs and labels). No monospace face. The stream canvas is invert + mix-blend-multiply with complemented --stream-* colours.
